stories.headline: Ant International partners with Visa, Mastercard on developing AI payments
stories.body: Visa, Mastercard and Ant International are working on common standards for AI-agent payments — including ways to verify and monitor their transactions.

stories.headline: Anthropic Missed Fourth Claude Network Breakout
